owners.ownership_type: Distributed generators of the scrap stream
owners.source_or_evidence: Scrap arises across many optical-fibre preform producers globally.

operators.operator_relationship_type: Generators / consolidators of the secondary stream
operators.source_or_evidence: Preform makers accumulate and consign germanium-bearing scrap for recycling.

identity.short_description: The largest secondary germanium stream — GeO2-in-glass soot, GeCl4 returns and reject preforms from optical-fibre manufacturing — consigned to refiner-recyclers (Umicore Olen, Umicore Quapaw, Vital/VPMS) for germanium reclamation.

operations.operating_configuration: Distributed secondary-material stream consolidated for recycling

operations.main_physical_function: Accumulates germanium-bearing optical-fibre manufacturing scrap and supplies it as recycling feed to germanium refiner-recyclers

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Collection and consolidation of germanium-bearing fibre scrap
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Sorting and consignment of soot, GeCl4 returns and reject preforms

outputs_produced.output_form: Ge-bearing fibre/preform scrap (GeO2-in-glass soot; GeCl4 returns; reject preforms)

operations.estimation_method: Industry characterisation of secondary germanium streams
